```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
billboard |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = wk6)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 5, color = "white") +
  labs(
    title = "Billboard Week 6 Rankings",
    subtitle = "Number of songs: 280",
    x = "Week 6 Rank",
    y = "Count"
  )
```

```{r}
billboard |> 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("wk"), 
    names_to = "week", 
    values_to = "rank",
    values_drop_na = TRUE
  ) |> 
  mutate(week = parse_number(week)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = week, y = rank, group = track)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.25) +
  scale_y_reverse()
```


```{r}
top10_long <- billboard |> 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("wk"), 
    names_to = "week", 
    values_to = "rank", 
    values_drop_na = TRUE
  ) |> 
  mutate(week = parse_number(week)) |> 
  group_by(artist, track) |> 
  filter(min(rank) <= 10) |> 
  ungroup()

notable_songs <- top10_long |> 
  filter(track %in% c("Music", "Amazed", "Higher"))

peak_points <- notable_songs |> 
  group_by(track) |> 
  slice_min(rank, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)

ggplot() +
  geom_line(
    data = top10_long, 
    aes(x = week, y = rank, group = track), 
    color = "gray80", 
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = notable_songs, 
    aes(x = week, y = rank, color = track), 
    linewidth = 1.1
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = peak_points,
    aes(x = week, y = rank, color = track),
    size = 3
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = peak_points,
    aes(x = week, y = rank, label = paste0(track, " (Peak: #", rank, ")")),
    vjust = -1,
    size = 3.5,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  labs(
    title = "Billboard Top 10 Songs in 2000",
    subtitle = "Highlighting fastest to #1, slowest to #1, and longest chart run",
    x = "Week",
    y = "Rank",
    color = "Song"
  )
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
music <- read_csv("data/music.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

```{r}
world <- map_data("world")

music |> 
  filter(!(artist.latitude == 0 & artist.longitude == 0), song.year > 0) |> 
  ggplot() +
  geom_map(
    data = world, map = world,
    aes(map_id = region),
    fill = "gray90", color = "gray70", linewidth = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(x = artist.longitude, y = artist.latitude, color = song.year),
    alpha = 0.5, size = 0.7
  ) +
  expand_limits(x = world$long, y = world$lat) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "plasma", name = "Year") +
  labs(
    title = "Song release year by artist location",
    subtitle = "Older recordings concentrate in the US and UK; newer recordings spread more globally",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Source: Million Song Dataset teaching CSV"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank())
```
